paper.title: Learning from Logged Implicit Exploration Data

settings.name_in_paper: Warm start problem for contextual exploration (offline learning from logged nonrandom exploration data)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Offline policy learning from logged data (not an interactive bandit problem).
unmapped: Data logged by an unknown sequence of fixed, possibly deterministic logging policies pi_1..pi_T; the learner estimates the logging propensities by regression
Comparison is to the best policy in a finite class H that has support at least tau under the averaged logging policy
settings.definition_quote: Formally, given a dataset of the form $S = (x,a,r_a)^*$ generated by the interaction of an uncontrolled logging policy, we want to construct a policy $h$ maximizing (or approximately maximizing) $V^h := E_{(x,\vec{r})\sim D}[ r_{h(x)} ]$.

algorithms.name: Empirical maximization of the thresholded importance-weighted estimator with estimated propensities

symbols.tau: threshold parameter in the estimator's denominator max{pi_hat(a|x), tau}
symbols.reg_bar: E_x[reg(x)], with reg(x) = max_a (pi(a|x) - pi_hat(a|x))^2 the squared error of the propensity estimate
symbols.N_exp: |H|, the size of the finite policy class

conditions: comparator h_tilde is the best policy in H with pi(h(x)|x) > tau for all x
logging policies pi_t are fixed and do not depend on the evaluation data
contexts and rewards are i.i.d. from D

source.label: t:opt
source.quote: Let $\hat\pi$ be any function from $X$ to distributions over actions $A$. Let $\cal H$ be any set of deterministic policies. Define $\tilde{\cal H} = \{ h\in\mathcal{H}~|~\pi(h(x)|x) > \tau, ~\forall ~x \in X \}$ and $\tilde{h} = \argmax_{h \in \tilde{ \mathcal{H} }} \{ V^h \}$. Let $\hat{h} = \argmax_{h \in {\mathcal{H}}} \{ \hat{V}_{\hat\pi}^{h} \}$ ... Then, with probability at least $1-\delta$, $V^{\hat{h}} \geq V^{\tilde{h}} - \frac{2}{\tau}( \sqrt{\EE_x[\reg(x)]} + \sqrt{\frac{\ln(2|H|/\delta)}{2T}} )$

results.notes: Offline generalisation bound on the gap V^{h_tilde} - V^{h_hat}, recorded as simple regret against the best tau-supported policy. T is the number of logged samples.

source.label: c:res_est
source.quote: Let $\hat\pi$ be any function from $X$ to distributions over actions $A$. Let $h:X \to A$ be any deterministic policy. If $\pi(h(x)|x) \geq \tau$ for all inputs $x$, then $|\EE[\hat{V}_{\hat\pi}^h]-V^h| \leq \frac{\sqrt{\EE_x[\reg(x)]}}{\tau}.$

results.notes: Bias bound for the policy-value estimator (a policy-evaluation guarantee, not regret). Lemma 3.1 gives related two-sided bias bounds and is not recorded separately.
